title.en: Decide how much you could lose before you decide how much to buy
title.zh-Hans: 先想能亏多少，再决定买多少

timing_note: Line and word timings are aligned to measured narration wavs (episodes/narration-timing.json); words are spread proportionally within each measured line. On-screen zh-Hans captions follow the English narration timing.

narration.command_template: python -m mlx_audio.tts.generate --model mlx-community/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base-8bit --lang_code en --ref_audio /Volumes/致态2TB/nx-agents/education/v2/voice-en-master-reference.wav --ref_text "Your KYC got rejected again? Don't worry. Most rejections come down to just a few simple mistakes. Let's fix them together." --text "<line>" --output_path <dir> --file_prefix <name>
narration.english_voice_instruct: a cheerful young American woman in her twenties, warm and energetic, clear diction, friendly YouTube tutorial host
narration.sam_voice_design_instruct: a friendly adult American man new to crypto, natural and conversational, clear diction, curious but not cartoonish
narration.sam_voice_note: Task-specific brief requests Sam lines with this distinct VoiceDesign model; this overrides the older global owner note that male voice was not used.

open_visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S2 · E16' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
open_visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第2季 · 第16集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。

shots.visual_en: Sam pushes the whole virtual balance toward one order while the other hand writes 'max loss 20'.
shots.visual_zh: 小白把全部虚拟余额推向一笔订单，另一只手写“最多亏二十”。

text.en: I have 1,000 and only want to lose 20. So I just put it all in?
text.zh-Hans: 我有一千，只想亏二十，那就先全买进去？

shots.source_visual_zh: 小白把全部虚拟余额推向一笔订单，另一只手写“最多亏二十”。

shots.visual_en: Three measuring cups: Account 1,000, Position ?, Planned risk 20. Clearly different volumes.
shots.visual_zh: 三只量杯写账户1000、仓位待定、计划风险20，体积清晰不同。

text.en: What's in your account, how much you buy in this trade, and the most you plan to lose are three different things. Decide your exit first. Then you can size the position.
text.zh-Hans: 账户里有多少、这一笔买多少、计划最多承担多少损失，是三件不同的事。先有退出条件，才能估算仓位。

shots.source_visual_zh: 三只量杯写账户1000、仓位待定、计划风险20，体积清晰不同。

shots.visual_en: Teaching entry 50,000, planned exit 47,500, distance 5%. No signal or recommendation shown.
shots.visual_zh: 教学入场50,000、计划退出47,500，价格差为5%；不显示推荐信号。

text.en: One practice sum. Entry at 50,000, planned exit at 47,500. That's 5% away. If you plan to take a 20 price loss, ignoring costs, the position is about 400.
text.zh-Hans: 只看一道练习题：入场五万，计划在四万七千五百退出，差百分之五。假设你计划承担二十的价格损失，忽略成本时，仓位约为四百。

shots.source_visual_zh: 教学入场50,000、计划退出47,500，价格差为5%；不显示推荐信号。

en: Teaching assumption · not a live price or real platform rate
zh-Hans: 教学假设 · 非实时行情，非平台真实费率

shots.visual_en: Formula 20 ÷ 5% = 400; 0.008 BTC; buy 400, not 20 and not 1,000.

text.en: So 'lose at most 20' doesn't mean 'buy only 20'?
text.zh-Hans: 原来“最多亏二十”，不等于“只买二十”？

text.en: Right. Here a 400 position falling 5% is the 20. These are teaching numbers only.
text.zh-Hans: 对。这里四百的仓位跌百分之五，才对应二十；这只是教学参数。

shots.visual_en: The real fill slips to a worse price, fee cards stack up, and the planned-risk marker changes to 'not a guaranteed cap'.
shots.visual_zh: 实际成交滑向更差位置，费用卡片叠加，计划风险标记变成“并非保证上限”。
shots.onscreen_text_en: Planned risk is not a cap

text.en: Real markets have slippage, gaps, fees and failed orders, so planned risk is not a guaranteed maximum loss. Never borrow money for this course, and never practise with money you need to live on.
text.zh-Hans: 真实行情会有滑点、跳空、费用或执行失败，所以计划风险不等于保证最多亏这么多。不要借钱来完成课程，也不要把生活必需资金当练习。

label.zh-Hans: 计划风险 ≠ 保证上限

shots.source_visual_zh: 实际成交滑向更差位置，费用卡片叠加，计划风险标记变成“并非保证上限”。

zh-Hans: 计划风险 ≠ 保证上限

shots.visual_en: Question card: 'Ignoring fees, a 400 position falls 5%. What's the price loss?'
shots.visual_zh: 题目：忽略费用时，400的仓位跌5%，价格损失是多少？

text.en: Work out the worst you can accept first. Then ask whether you need this trade at all.
text.zh-Hans: 先算最坏能接受什么，再看你是否需要这笔交易。

question.en: Ignoring fees, a 400 position falls 5%. What's the price loss?
question.zh-Hans: 不计费用，400 的仓位下跌 5%，价格亏损是多少？

shots.source_visual_zh: 题目：忽略费用时，400的仓位跌5%，价格损失是多少？

text.en: You set a stop-loss. Does that mean you can only lose that amount? Next: the truth about stops.
text.zh-Hans: 设好了止损，就一定只亏这么多吗？下一集：止损的真相。

text.en: You set a stop-loss. Does that mean you can only lose that amount? Next: the truth about stops.
text.zh-Hans: 设好了止损，就一定只亏这么多吗？下一集：止损的真相。

end_hook.visual_en: End hook (4 s): quick teaser of the next problem — a single striking image from the next episode's opening, frozen on the moment of doubt; Sam reacts, Nexubo's antenna blinks amber. Text card with the hook line.
end_hook.visual_zh: 片尾钩子（4秒）：下一集开场矛盾的一个定格画面，停在“犯疑问”的瞬间；小白反应，小纳天线琥珀灯闪。字卡显示钩子台词。

close_visual_en: Branded close (4 s): logo mark + wordmark lockup, series name, tagline 'Understand first, then act.', small slogan line 'One verified gateway to the world's exchanges', 'nexualpha.com' as plain text (the clickable entry lives on the web page). Nexubo waves, antenna green.
close_visual_zh: 品牌片尾（4秒）：标志图形＋文字标、系列名、“先看懂，再动手。”、小号品牌标语“全球交易所，一个官方入口”；“nexualpha.com”为识别文字（可点击入口在网页）。小纳挥手，天线绿灯。

goal.en: Understand that account balance, position size and planned risk are three different numbers.
goal.zh-Hans: 理解账户资金、仓位金额和计划风险不是同一个数字。

page_cta.line_en: Try the position-size calculator in the practice panel below. Teaching numbers only.
page_cta.line_zh: 用下方练习面板里的仓位计算器试一试，仅为教学数字。
page_cta.placement: directly beside / under the video player; never gates the lesson

exercise.task_en: Given an entry, a stop distance and a teaching risk budget, work out the virtual position size.
exercise.task_zh: 根据给定入场、止损距离和教学风险预算，算出虚拟仓位。
exercise.answer_en: 400 USDT notional spot amount; 0.008 BTC; fees and execution differences are extra.
exercise.answer_zh: 400 USDT名义现货金额；0.008 BTC；费用和执行偏差需另计。
